sloka: ततः प्रज्वालयित्वाग्निं तावुभौ हरीराक्षसौ ।भ्रातृत्वमुपसम्पन्नौ परिष्वज्य परस्परम् ।। ७.३४.४२ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ prajvālayitvāgniṁ tāvubhau harīrākṣasau ।bhrātṛtvamupasampannau pariṣvajya parasparam ।। 7.34.42 ॥

translations.english: Then, having kindled a fire, both the monkey (Hanuman) and the Rakshasa (Vibhishana) established their brotherhood and embraced each other.
